2058. Display Students Above Given Marks

60

Medium

Write a Java program to simulate retrieving student records from a database based on a marks condition.

The program should read N student records containing:

Student ID
Student Name
Marks

Then read a minimum marks value.

Display all students whose marks are greater than or equal to the given value.

The output format should be:

ID: <id>, Name: <name>, Marks: <marks>

If no student satisfies the condition, display:

No students found
